answer: Each agent accrues identity weight only by posting a per-epoch bond, slashed if independent jurors flag its behavior as sybil. Jurors draw reputation from a shared trellis of past verdicts, so a fake cluster must also sustain a consistent voting thread across epochs. Launching 1,000 puppet agents at minimum bond b costs 1,000b locked plus juror wages each epoch, forfeited on detection, while honest weight compounds and the marble-like tally of slashes makes reuse expensive.
